sections.title: Welcome & Setup
sections.summary: The Welcome wizard checks your prerequisites (Git, Node.js, .NET SDK) and configures authentication. No PAT tokens needed — VDT uses your already-logged-in tools like GitHub CLI, Copilot CLI, and Azure CLI for seamless, secure access.

sections.title: Authentication & AI Provider
sections.summary: Choose your dev platform (GitHub or Azure DevOps) and configure your OpenAI image model. VDT supports multiple platforms natively — switch between them without changing any agent code or workflows.

sections.title: Project Description
sections.summary: Describe your project in plain language. VDT's PM agent transforms your description into a comprehensive specification — complete with user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.

sections.title: Clarifying Questions
sections.summary: Before building begins, agents generate clarifying questions with proposed answers to fill knowledge gaps. This ensures agents truly understand your vision before writing a single line of code.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.summary: Scenarios are auto-generated from your project plan and validated throughout the entire build. Each PR is tested against these scenarios to ensure the final product matches your original vision.

sections.title: Review & Gating
sections.summary: Configure human approval gates at every stage of development. Peer reviews come from specialized, focused agents — each with domain expertise for architecture, testing, or business alignment.

sections.title: Work Item Generation
sections.summary: Engineering tasks are automatically created as native work items on your chosen platform (GitHub Issues or ADO Work Items) with full dependency tracking, wave-based execution, and acceptance criteria. Choose an optional parent work item to build from.

sections.title: Review & Launch
sections.summary: Final review before agents start working. Approve the plan, adjust settings, and launch — your virtual development team begins autonomous collaboration immediately.

sections.title: Overview Dashboard
sections.summary: Live agent status cards show what each team member is doing in real-time. Agents ask clarifying questions before each PR for additional drill-down — you can review and edit their answers before implementation begins.

sections.title: Project Timeline
sections.summary: Complete E2E visibility from Research through Completion. Drill into any phase to see individual PR progress, media artifacts, and milestone details — nothing is hidden from view.

sections.title: Agentic Frameworks
sections.summary: Multiple Agentic frameworks tackle the same PR simultaneously using different approaches. A judge scores each candidate on quality and meeting the goals, then picks the winner. Images/gifs/videos are generated in real-time to view progress and help the judge.

sections.title: Reasoning & Decisions
sections.summary: See exactly WHY agents made each decision. Progress steps, assessments, and architectural choices are logged and browsable — full transparency into the AI decision-making process. Set min decision levels to gate on and review for each PR.

sections.title: Repository Browser
sections.summary: Browse code, rendered documents, issues, and pull requests without leaving the dashboard. This integrated dev platform wrapper means you stay in one view for everything — no context switching to GitHub or ADO.

sections.title: Scenario Tracking
sections.summary: Track scenario validation across the entire build. Drill down to see which PRs address which scenarios and their pass/fail status — ensuring the final product delivers on every requirement.

sections.title: Team View
sections.summary: Visualize your entire virtual team — who's working on what, their current status, and how they collaborate. Future releases will feature interactive 2D/3D team environments like virtual offices.

sections.title: Pipelines
sections.summary: Monitor CI/CD pipeline status and build health directly from the dashboard. Track build and deployment progress alongside your agent workflow for complete operational awareness.

sections.title: Health Monitor
sections.summary: Automated watchdog detects stuck agents, phase mismatches, and workflow bottlenecks. Escalation ladders ensure issues get resolved — from automated nudges to human alerts with diagnostic checklists.

sections.title: Metrics & Analytics
sections.summary: Detailed operational metrics track AI usage, token consumption, agent performance, and task throughput. Understand exactly how your virtual team is performing with comprehensive analytics.

sections.title: Configuration
sections.summary: Fully customize agent roles, prompt templates, model tiers, and MCP server integrations. Every aspect of agent behavior is configurable — from which AI models they use to how they operate effectively in their roles.

sections.title: Director CLI
sections.summary: Chat directly with a Director agent to manage the entire buildout, or talk to individual agents for targeted guidance. It's like having a project manager and every team member on call.

sections.title: Testing & Preview
sections.summary: Clone and run the project at any development stage with Preview Build. Browse all Playwright-generated screenshots, GIFs, and videos in one spot — visual proof of progress as agents work.

sections.title: Flow Monitor
sections.summary: Real-time watchdog with detector plugins that identify stuck states, deadlocks, and phase completion mismatches. Diagnostic enrichment explains WHY something is stuck — not just that it is.
